tagline.en: Physical Intelligence's pi0 — a flow-based vision-language-action foundation model for robot control.
tagline.zh: Physical Intelligence 的 pi0——一个基于 flow 的视觉-语言-动作机器人控制基础模型。

en: pi0 is a vision-language-action foundation model from Physical Intelligence, released through their open OpenPI project. It maps camera observations and a language instruction into continuous robot actions, generating smooth action chunks so a robot can carry out manipulation tasks described in plain language.

Built on a vision-language backbone with a flow-based action expert, pi0 is designed as a generalist policy that can be adapted across robot embodiments and tasks. In WorldFoundry it runs on the in-tree OpenPI runtime with a pi0-specific configuration.
This is an action-generation model: given observations it emits an action trace rather than producing video. The policy checkpoint is obtained separately before you roll it out.
zh: pi0 是 Physical Intelligence 推出的视觉-语言-动作基础模型，通过其开放的 OpenPI 项目发布。它把相机观测和一条语言指令映射为连续的机器人动作，生成平滑的动作片段，使机器人能完成用自然语言描述的操作任务。
pi0 建立在视觉-语言主干之上，并配有一个基于 flow 的动作专家模块，被设计为可跨机器人本体和任务适配的通用策略。在 WorldFoundry 中，它运行于内置的 OpenPI 运行时，并采用 pi0 专属配置。
这是一个动作生成模型：给定观测，它输出的是一段动作轨迹，而非视频。策略 checkpoint 需在推演前单独获取。

whenToUse.en: Reach for pi0 when you want a generalist vision-language-action policy that turns camera input and language instructions into robot actions, and prefer a flow-based approach to smooth action generation.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个通用的视觉-语言-动作策略，把相机输入和语言指令转成机器人动作，并偏好基于 flow 的平滑动作生成时，可以选择 pi0。

notFor.en: An action-generation policy, not a video-generation model — it outputs action traces. The policy checkpoint is supplied separately.
notFor.zh: 它是动作生成策略，而非视频生成模型——输出的是动作轨迹。策略 checkpoint 需单独提供。
